name: claude-remote
description: Continue this workspace's Claude Code conversations from a phone on the same LAN: full history, live progress, send-now or queue-after-turn prompts, end-to-end AES-256-GCM encryption with a resettable pairing key. Works in VS Code and Git Graph Studio.

claudeRemote.port.description: LAN server port. 0 reuses the last port (or picks a free one), so paired phones keep their bookmark.

claudeRemote.autoStart.description: Start the LAN server when the window opens.

enumDescriptions: Open the conversation's Claude Code tab when a phone turn starts, and reload it when the turn ends so it shows the phone's turn and continues from it
Only open (or reveal) the tab when a phone turn starts
claudeRemote.desktopTab.description: What a phone prompt does to the conversation's Claude Code tab on this desktop.

enumDescriptions: Type the phone's prompt into the conversation's Claude Code tab and send it from there (Git Graph Studio); the desktop and the phone show the same turn. Falls back to headless where the host cannot.
Run the phone's prompt through the claude CLI in the background
claudeRemote.backend.description: How a phone prompt runs on this desktop.
